summary.note: rows are research candidates with recorded evidence and per-field support maps; only lodging-hotel rows with a fetched OFFICIAL property page and a source-supported address enter the generated batch-010 SQL review candidate. ALL 10 attractions are held out: the restaurants.category constraint (7 values) has no 'attraction' category — a schema decision by the human owner is required first. Nothing here is DB-verified; every inserted row stays verification_status='unverified'.

schemaBlocker.attractions: restaurants.category CHECK allows only restaurant|hotel|tiffin|cafe|fast_food|street_food|bakery_sweets (migration-001). Storing a temple/fort/waterfall under a food category would be dishonest. All attraction rows below are HELD OUT until the owner approves a schema change (new category or separate table).
schemaBlocker.hotels: No schema fields exist for star rating, check-in/check-out, room types, structured amenities, nightly price, or booking links. source_url is provenance (not a booking URL). price_level '₹₹' is the documented neutral default (its brackets are cost-for-two oriented); rating stays 0 ('not captured'). Unsupported hotel fields are therefore NOT stored.
